personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT (Adapted for clean iOS-Native utility. Matte, calm, organic touches, highly structured)
personality_one_liner: A premium, calm, warm, and trustworthy family operating system that prioritizes structured organization while feeling human and approachable.

spacing.rule: Generous rhythm. 16-24pt responsive screen padding. Elements within cards use 12-16pt spacing.

do's: Use subtle semi-transparent tints over surfaceSecondary if depth is required, but avoid true blur to maintain the flat, organic matte look of the Journal/Utility fusion.
dont's: No heavy glassmorphism, no Apple-style heavy blur overlays. Keep it flat, clean, and fast.

screens.name: Home / Family Dashboard
screens.purpose: A unified 'Today' dashboard showing upcoming events, tasks, and nightly planning at a glance.

states.empty: Clean illustration with a 'Plan your day' primary CTA

screens.layout: Left-aligned info-heavy layout. Stacked Card components. Avoid standard dense grid; use clear vertical rhythm. Primary CTA floating or sticky bottom if adding quick tasks.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of the family's schedule and tasks, with Month, Week, Day, and Task views.

states.empty: No events today: subtle empty state with 'Add Event' CTA
states.error: Cannot load calendar: clear error with retry

screens.layout: Header: ‹ August 2026 › Today + Add. Filter chips horizontally scrollable. Agenda list below calendar grid. Event cards show title, time, who (avatars/colors), place. Family colors used as left-border or subtle tint. Multi-line titles wrap, never truncate.

screens.name: Tasks & Chores
screens.purpose: Actionable checklist of responsibilities with clear states and easy entry.

states.empty: Illustration + 'All caught up! Add a new chore'

screens.layout: ListRows with ghost button aesthetic. Striktethrough for completed. Bottom sheet for complex task creation. Filter chips at the top. 'Add a task' persistent text input field at the bottom (or FAB).

screens.name: Family Vault
screens.purpose: Secure repository for insurance, medical, and home documents.
screens.layout: Highly structured, left-aligned, plain-language summaries. Cards with icons for document types. Atomic design elements. Bottom tabs hidden if this is deeply nested.

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT TYPOGRAPHY RULE: Never exceed font weight 500 anywhere in the codebase. Use the typography scale strictly by size to carry hierarchy (3xl=28, 2xl=24, xl=20, lg=18, base=16, sm=14, xs=13). Implement mapping: PageTitle=3xl, SectionTitle=xl, CardTitle=lg, Body=base, Labels/Supporting=sm, Metadata=xs.

STRICT TEXT OVERFLOW RULE (ZERO TOLERANCE): Text must NEVER overflow, clip, or cross card/button edges. Remove all hardcoded heights from text containers. Use flexShrink: 1 on text containers next to icons. Set numberOfLines to undefined (or omit it) so text strictly wraps to multiple lines. This is a critical usability mandate.

BUTTON ANATOMY: Min height 48px to 56px. Ensure button labels can wrap if extremely long. Implement primary, secondary, tertiary, destructive, and emergency variants using the exact color tokens. Do not shrink font size to fit.

ALIGNMENT SYSTEM: Apply 'alignItems: flex-start' and 'textAlign: left' for all info-heavy screens (Calendar, Tasks, Vault). Reserve 'alignItems: center' and 'textAlign: center' ONLY for onboarding, empty states, and success toasts.

SHARED PRIMITIVES TO BUILD: Create standard reusable wrappers: <Screen> (handles SafeArea + standard padding 16-24pt), <ScreenHeader>, <SectionHeader>, <EmptyState>, <ErrorState>, <SkeletonLoader>, <Toast>, <Chip>, <Badge>, <BottomSheet>, <ConfirmDialog>, <ListRow>. Ensure these are used globally.

CALENDAR BLUEPRINT: Build a sticky header '‹ Month YYYY › | Today | +'. Below header, use horizontal scrollable <Chip>s for filters (All/Mine/Kids/Helpers). Month view must show readable cells with '+N more' (avoid dense grids). Agenda view below it. Family colors must only be a left-border (3-4px width) or subtle background tint on the event card, NOT loud blocks. Include multi-person overlapping avatars.
ANIMATIONS: Use Reanimated for micro-interactions. Duration: 150-300ms. Apply scale-down (0.97) on press for cards/buttons, smooth bottom-sheet slides, and satisfying task-complete morphs.
No blue or purple colors allowed anywhere in the app. Adhere exactly to the warm coral + botanical provided palette.
Do not use emojis in system UI or navigation. Emojis are reserved EXCLUSIVELY for emotional warmth features (e.g., Send Hug, Birthdays). Use Feather icons for all UI controls.
Avoid glassmorphism. This app relies on flat, matte, native clean surfaces to reduce cognitive load and visual noise.
